audience.target: Hindi-speaking rural/village viewers and urban lower-/middle-class households
audience.priority: verified, relatable, conversation-worthy public-interest, agriculture, prices, consumer, transport, weather, health, education and human-interest stories

stories.claim: Nine UP sugar mills had started crushing and 33 had issued cane indents; Dhampur local weighing starts 8 Nov and crushing inauguration is shifted to 11 Nov after rain/waterlogging.
stories.confidence: high; department figures reported by multiple sources; Dhampur timing attributed to local mill management
stories.caveat: Do not imply all UP mills have started; farmers should check their own indent and committee schedule.

stories.claim: About 220 kg rasgullas destroyed after flies were found; shop issued a notice; samples collected for quality testing.
stories.confidence: high for destruction/notice; lab results not located
stories.caveat: Do not call this laboratory-proven chemical adulteration; distinguish hygiene action from sample result.

stories.claim: Three farmers climbed a water tank on 4 Nov demanding ₹700/quintal sugarcane price, pre-season price announcement and interest on arrears; local reports said protest continued late on 4 Nov.
stories.confidence: high for reported event and demands; no verified 5 Nov morning resolution
stories.caveat: ₹700 is a demand, not an announced government rate; avoid graphic or celebratory treatment of a dangerous protest tactic.

stories.claim: Traffic plan 5–11 Nov, 07:00–02:00; heavy-vehicle diversions; Abu Lane closed to vehicles and Sarafa market to four-wheelers.
stories.confidence: high; Jagran and Hindustan reports dated 5 Nov cross-checked
stories.caveat: Restrictions are route/market-specific; not a blanket closure of Meerut.

stories.claim: September 2026 CPI 5.54%, food inflation 7.74%, rural food 8.06%, urban food 7.18%; onion annual inflation 108.09%; weak soil moisture creates rabi and food-price risks.
stories.confidence: high for September official CPI; Reuters describes future risk, not guaranteed price increases
stories.caveat: Lagged September data, not 5 Nov mandi prices; do not say every market will rise.

stories.claim: WGC says Q3 2026 Indian gold demand fell 29% year-on-year to 162.5 tonnes; jewellery demand down 20%, investment down 40%.
stories.confidence: high; Reuters/WGC and two other outlets
stories.caveat: National demand trend, not local store sales or current retail gold rate.

stories.claim: TRAI Fourth Amendment dated 2 Nov sets 24/7 complaint centres, at least 16 hours of human representatives, AI disclosure/oversight and penalties for improper complaint handling.
stories.confidence: high; official TRAI listing plus NDTV Profit and Business Standard; detailed PDF not fetched
stories.caveat: Do not promise immediate complaint resolution or add unverified appeal deadlines.

stories.claim: FSSAI and PepsiCo/Monster dispute use of the 'energy drink' descriptor; Delhi HC interim order addressed existing labelled stock and fresh manufacture; hearing listed 5 Nov.
stories.confidence: medium-high; Reuters and legal/news reporting; no 5 Nov order found by 08:16 IST
stories.caveat: Not a finding that products are poisonous and not a nationwide total ban; refresh court update before publishing.

stories.claim: Cabinet approved ₹14,500 crore VGF for 92 GWh grid-scale storage capacity: 60 GWh pumped hydro, 30 GWh batteries, 2 GWh emerging technologies, FY2026-27 to FY2030-31.
stories.confidence: high; PMIndia official release and DD India/Moneycontrol
stories.caveat: New capacity is yet to be commissioned; no claim of immediate household bill reduction.

stories.claim: Cabinet extended/strengthened FTSC scheme to 31 Mar 2031 with ₹3,788.04 crore outlay and provision to expand from 779 to up to 850 courts, including exclusive POCSO courts.
stories.confidence: high; PMIndia official release, India Today and Hindustan Times
stories.caveat: 850 is a provision/target, not a count of already functioning courts; avoid graphic detail.

stories.claim: India begin SAFF Championship title defence against Pakistan in Dhaka on 5 Nov at 15:00 IST; AIFF says Veto app stream.
stories.confidence: high; AIFF primary fixture and two news previews
stories.caveat: Preview only at 08:16 IST; no result yet. Keep strictly sporting, not communal/political.

stories.claim: Ramayana: Part One scheduled for theatrical release 5 Nov; trade-tracker advance booking figures reported on 3 Nov include blocked seats.
stories.confidence: medium; Financial Express and Indian Express citing trade-tracker data
stories.caveat: Advance bookings are estimates, not actual box-office revenue; no poster, film still or actor likeness used.
